description: Top-level index cross-referencing extracted hyperMILL modules — tool database, stock + fixture, simulation, automation center, post processor. Consumed by HyperMillFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery, dependency tracing, and AI orchestration.

modules.description: Tool holder, cutter geometry, cutting data, wear limits, coating, and metadata fields surfaced in the hyperMILL tool database UI. Inputs to Kienzle force model and Taylor tool life.
Stock model definition and workholding/fixture catalog parameters including clamping force, jaw geometry, and pull-out resistance. Feeds prism_safety workholding gate.
Material removal simulation, collision check, and machine kinematic verification settings. Consumes tool_database geometry and stock_fixture clamps.
hyperMILL Automation Center (AC) macro library, template inheritance, and feature recognition rules. Drives autonomous toolpath generation.
PPG (Post Processor Generator) configuration: controller dialect, kinematic chain, NC code emit options, RTCP/G68.2 enable flags.
